items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: I'll be John Brown. I'll be John Brown if you don't know where.

ctx.x: How would the guys in the clubs dress in those times?

White, white, uh, what, black, black shirt. That's it for, for, for funeral, what you mean? For parade? For parade, the guys in the clubs. Oh, what, for, for parade? Have white, alright. They have a white shirt, black black pants and a black tie. And what they, what they kept, you know what I mean? With the cap.

I wouldn't been to the Connemy Hall, the San Sioux Hall, you know where the San Sioux Hall is there? The St. Dominic. I don't know where that's at. That's up in Coctin. That's up on the bridge between Genet and Hickory. But it's mostly locally on the riverside. That's where it's at. I done been to most of all them. And the San Siouxs, I done been there so many times. San Siouxs, the Connemy Hall, the New Hall, the Copper Reds Hall. Them Halls, I used to know them. I know them all. I believe your wife put her…
